prompt: Show monthly revenue for product class code 22975 in 2022 as a line chart
visualization_goal: Line chart showing monthly revenue for product class code 22975 in 2022
gt_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(Sold_Date AS DATE)) AS month_start, ROUND(SUM(Total_Sale_Value), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(Sold_Date AS DATE)) = 2022 AND Product_Class_Code = 22975 GROUP BY month_start ORDER BY month_start ASC
gt_analysis: Monthly revenue for product class 22975 in 2022 ranges from $73,802.56 (July) to $122,319.24 (December), with a mid-year trough and a strong year-end peak.

prompt: Show total revenue by store type for 2023 as a bar chart
visualization_goal: Bar chart showing total 2023 revenue by store type
gt_sql: SELECT st.store_type, ROUND(SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON s.Store_Number = st.Store_Number WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(s.Sold_Date AS DATE)) = 2023 GROUP BY st.store_type ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, st.store_type ASC

prompt: Show promo revenue share by product category for 2023 as a bar chart, expressing the share as a percentage of total revenue
visualization_goal: Bar chart showing the share of revenue generated under promotion for each product category in 2023
gt_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.On_Promo = 1 THEN s.Total_Sale_Value ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value), 0) * 100, 2) AS promo_revenue_share FROM sales s JOIN products p ON s.SKU_Coded = p.SKU_Coded WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(s.Sold_Date AS DATE)) = 2023 GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY promo_revenue_share DESC, p.category ASC
